---
title: "New Instrument Metadata Format"
format: html
---

This script was used to create a new metadata sheet for Eyes on Kelp Index continuous environmental sensor data. 

Main changes include converting file from wide format to long, so each datafile points to a new row.


## Setup

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(googledrive)
library(googlesheets4)
library(lubridate)


# Link to the metadata sheet
metadata_file_url = "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1JJ4Vtb_pI9FJRvMYg7pbhQzM6JPcFzGVU3rR9IdYnGQ/edit?gid=1334564098#gid=1334564098"

# Name of the tab with the file metadata
sheet_name = " Deployments_IndexOnly"
```
